title: Polski · RUPL v0.2
path_order_note: Path-54: full A1 canopy (48 live) + A2 begun 2026-08-04 (a2_past_byc, a2_weather live; rest of A2 draft spine planned, skipped by live walk). A2 decisions 2026-08-04: full both-gender past production; singular first (a2_past_plural split, after plural-Nom); imperfective-only until a2_aspect; interleave grammar+vocab; explain fields authored from A2 unit 1.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · być
nodes.note: First past unit — SINGULAR only, both genders in production (James 2026-08-04); plural split to a2_past_plural after plural-Nom. Gender agreement = payoff of A1 gender work.

nodes.label: Czas · wczoraj i dawniej
nodes.note: Past time words: 10 chunks/adverbs riding a2_past_byc. Bare adverbs vs fixed w-phrases split into two blocks.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · -ać
nodes.note: Past of -ac/-owac verbs, singular both genders. One rule: infinitive minus c + l + person ending. Imperfective only.

nodes.label: Pogoda
nodes.note: Frames pack riding a2_past_byc: pada→padał pairs + 6 new words (zimno, mgła, burza, mróz, upał, pochmurno). Nouns/seasons recycled from a1_nature — NOT re-taught.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · reszta
nodes.note: Same past rule on -ic/-ec verbs + whole-form mialem/chcialem (e->a shift deliberately NOT explained until B1). Teaches infinitive miec (gap closed 2026-08-04).

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · trening
nodes.note: Gym: gender + person discrimination across all taught past forms. Zero new material. Wczoraj-framed.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · Jak było?
nodes.note: Chunk unit riding the past block: Jak bylo? / Co slychac? / Nic nowego. Teaches the adverb dobrze (real gap - course had only adjective dobry). Perfective "Jak minal weekend?" replaced 2026-08-05 with "Jak bylo w weekend?".

nodes.label: Uczucia i nastroje
nodes.note: Feelings riding past+adjective: Bylem zmeczony / Bylam smutna. 7 NEW adjectives only - a1_freetime already owned szczesliwy/smutny/zly and a1_trunk_adjectives owned zmeczony. Both genders on the board.

nodes.label: Liczba mnoga · -y/-i/-a/-e
nodes.note: Non-virile plural Nom/Acc (identical - taught as the gift). -y / -i after k,g / -e soft / neuter -a; adjectives always -e. k/g rule is the a1_gen_ki payoff. Suppletives + virile fenced.

nodes.label: Czas przeszły · liczba mnoga
nodes.note: Plural past: -li = any group with a man, -ly = everything else. Byc + mieszkac + robic, all six persons. Teaches the conjunction "i" (and) - a real gap, nothing taught it before. Virile system stays B1.

nodes.label: Rodzina 2
nodes.note: 12 new family nouns incl. plural-only rodzice/dzieci (taught whole - both are irregular and fenced from plural_nom). Rides past_plural for 3 sentences.

nodes.label: Dopełniacz · liczba mnoga
nodes.note: Genitive plural, REGULAR ONLY: masc -ow, fem/neut zero-ending on non-shifting stems. Every vowel-shift and fleeting-e stem fenced, including pies->psow and samochod->samochodow (both dropped by the author as stem-changing - correct).

nodes.label: Stacja 1 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer (parked design): ending-cloze, cumulative A1+early-A2 bank, speed emphasis.

nodes.label: Liczby 5+ · dopełniacz
nodes.note: 2-4 + Nom pl, 5+ + Gen pl. Teaches dwie (fem two), dolary/dolarow, godziny/minuty, lata/lat. Ile masz lat? is the payoff. Teens (11-19) behave as 5+ - caught by the author, without it the age payoff induces *dwanascie lata.

nodes.label: Zakupy i pieniądze
nodes.note: SECOND layer of money vocab - all 14 original candidates were already owned by a1_shopping. 19 genuinely new: moneta, banknot, bankomat, konto, platnosc, kredyt, sprzedawca, koszyk, wozek, prezent, wydawac, zarabiac, oszczedzac, bogaty, biedny. zloty omitted (adjectival declension).

nodes.label: Rozmówki · w sklepie
nodes.note: Shop chunks. Instrumental karta/gotowka quarantined as frozen phrases - case never named. zaplacic -> placic (perfective ban). Poprosze kept as an opaque politeness word despite being formally perfective.

nodes.label: Narzędnik · z kimś
nodes.note: z + Instrumental for company. Same endings as a1_inst_job, second job. -a masculines (tata->tata, kolega->kolega) and k->-iem (wujek->wujkiem) taught. Plural inst, z mezem and z przyjacielem fenced.

nodes.label: Ludzie · wygląd i charakter
nodes.note: 11 new character/looks adjectives x both genders. TONE: brzydki/glupi/gruby/chudy/slaby deliberately never aimed at a named relative - weather, films, animals, a thick book, the speaker himself. Family sentences are all compliments.

nodes.label: Jechać · jadę czy idę?
nodes.note: jechac = go BY VEHICLE vs already-known ide = on foot. Endings are the -e/-esz class he owns; only the ja-/je- stem swap is new. Teaches the infinitive jechac (untaught before). isc deliberately left to a2_chodzic, so the contrast is live only at ja/ty - that unit must close it.

nodes.label: Narzędnik · czym jedziesz?
nodes.note: Bare instrumental of means - NO preposition. z+vehicle planted as a wrong choice in 7 of 12 quiz items so the English-interference error is repeatedly rejected. Third job of one case: identity, company, means. samochodem taught whole (o->o shift), auto->autem beside it as the shift-free case.

nodes.label: Podróż · logistyka
nodes.note: 11 new travel nouns + spozniony/spozniona. Two soft-ending gender traps taught explicitly: bagaz is m despite -z, podroz is f despite the consonant.

nodes.label: Rozmówki · droga
nodes.note: Street directions. "Jak dojsc do...?" DROPPED (dojsc perfective) and replaced with "Ktoredy do...?" which has no verb slot at all, so aspect cannot arise. isc carried as an opaque block, never named or conjugated. Ordinals dropped with the "first street on the left" function.

nodes.label: Wakacje
nodes.note: Holidays. wakacje turned out to be ALREADY taught by a1_freetime (recycled, not re-taught). gory is genuinely new (a1 taught only singular gora). Locative chunks na plazy / w gorach taught as forms since neither noun is usable without them.

nodes.label: Kraje i języki
nodes.note: Countries, nationalities, languages, aimed at an ENGLISH learner: Jestem Anglikiem / Nie mowie po polsku. Capitalisation taught as content via Polska vs polska ksiazka. Feminine nationalities included (Polka/Polka) because a1_inst_job already drilled the -ka/-ka slot. po polsku / po angielsku taught as opaque whole chunks, never analysed against the adjective polski. England tag-sequence flag emoji removed - does not render on Win10.

nodes.label: Iść czy chodzić?
nodes.note: Closes the isc grid a2_jechac left open (all six persons) + habitual chodzic. Now-vs-habit carried by teraz/codziennie, not grammar talk. Teaches codziennie (was untaught). jezdzic fenced, named nowhere.

nodes.label: Stacja 2 · tempo
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] PLACEHOLDER — rep layer: past tense + plural + Inst in the bank.

nodes.label: Czasowniki z się
nodes.note: Verbs that travel with sie. Framed as a word belonging to the verb, NEVER as "self". Hook is Jak sie masz? (genuinely taught) - NOT nazywam sie, which turned out to be untaught anywhere. spotykac sie dropped: it governs z+Inst and would make this a two-system unit.

nodes.label: Dzień codzienny
nodes.note: Daily routine, built to a five-line connected day - the first paragraph-shaped thing he can say. sie verbs framed exactly as a2_sie: sie belongs to the verb, never "self", and the English glosses (wake up / have a wash / get dressed) carry no self either. Closes two real gaps: jem/jesz (present of jesc) and the infinitive wracac were taught nowhere.

nodes.label: Dom i meble
nodes.note: Home + furniture. Every locative verified individually: w kuchni / w sypialni / w lazience are NOT taught anywhere, so those rooms are left out of every sentence rather than sneaking the forms in (the biuro/biurze trap).

nodes.label: Czas przyszły · będę
nodes.note: Compound future bede + infinitive. Two gifts named explicitly: it is the same shape as moge+infinitive he already builds, and the future has NO gender after a whole block of bylem/bylam. Perfective future and bede pisal both fenced. Copular future (bede w domu) deliberately excluded - bede byc is not Polish.

nodes.label: Muszę · można · trzeba
nodes.note: musze + infinitive, plus the invariable impersonals mozna/trzeba framed as situation-not-person. Negation deliberately kept out entirely: nie musze and nie mozna both flip meaning and setting them against each other is past A2. warto dropped as load for no survival gain.

nodes.label: Praca 2
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] ~14 new: zarabiać, urlop, klient, zebranie recycled(spotkanie), umowa, szukać pracy chunk, bezrobotny, zawód, doświadczenie.

nodes.label: Nauka
nodes.note: [A2 DRAFT SPINE 2026-08-03] ~14 new: uczyć się payoff, egzamin, lekcja, zadanie, błąd, poprawka(!), zdać, oblać, ocena, kurs, ćwiczenie, słówko.

nodes.label: Pary czasowników
nodes.note: Aspect named at last, PAST ONLY. Four twins (kupic/zrobic/wypic/przeczytac) taught as pairs to learn whole - NO prefix rule, because z-/wy-/prze-/nothing is genuinely unpredictable and a rule would be false. gotowac/ugotowac dropped: gotowac has no past form taught anywhere, so there was no imperfective to contrast against. Perfective FUTURE fenced absolutely - verified zero occurrences - so it cannot contradict a2_bedzie. Beginner fallback taught explicitly: when unsure use the imperfective, since the perfective adds the completion claim you can be wrong about.
